newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 23.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Dec. 23:

WASHINGTON - House Republican leaders, saying they want to get the ethics controversy behind them as early as possible, hope the House can vote on punishing Speaker Newt Gingrich Jan. 7, the same day lawmakers are to vote on whether to make him the first Republican re-elected speaker in 68 years.

WASHINGTON - In the fullness of his rise to power, House Speaker Newt Gingrich often boasted that he saw himself as "a transformational figure" who was systematically out to "shift the entire planet" through his energy, his ideas and his vision of a post-welfare-state America.

WASHINGTON - CIA Inspector General Frederick Hitz has reopened an investigation into the failure of agency clandestine officers to report allegations of torture by a CIA-supported Honduran military intelligence unit in the mid-1980s.
WASHINGTON - The Washington Redskins football team win their last game at RFK Stadium before next season's move to a new venue.
WASHINGTON - Sexual harassment evokes a wide range of responses, with some employers overreacting and others underreacting in pursuit of workplace offenders.
